element: Apple sign-in on the web (provider setup)
found: [owner] Owner decision 2026-10-24: Apple only on the web; Google, X and Snapchat are hidden. The Apple button renders when NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_CLIENT_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_REDIRECT_URI are set; the owner must create the Apple Services ID, register the return URL and set both (also as Dockerfile build args in deploy/docker/Dockerfile.patient-web, outside this session's scope).
suspect: Until configured the button stays hidden (no fake button). Backend must verify the Apple identity token on POST /auth/social-login.

element: resend countdown 300 s vs 60 s in the app
found: [backend] POST /auth/otp/request is throttled to 3 per 10 minutes, so the web waits 300 s; the app waits 60 s and would hit 429 after 3 sends.
suspect: Reviewer to decide one cooldown and one throttle for both clients.

element: register creates the account before the OTP step
found: [backend] app sends OTP first; backend flow on web is register then OTP (?sent=0 leaves an account without a code).
suspect: Flow is backend-defined; not changed by design session.

element: no OTP-based reset on the web
found: [backend] app goes forgot -> OTP -> reset with the code; web POST /auth/password/forgot mails a reset token the person types on /password-reset.
suspect: Needs an OTP reset endpoint the web can call.

element: no app version on the web
found: [owner] the web has no build version string to show; confirm whether a build id should be exposed.
suspect: Needs an owner choice of what the version is.

element: notification kinds: web edits categories/channels, app edits flat flags
found: [backend] PATCH /users/me/notification-settings validates the flat keys the app sends (general, offers, medications, doctorMessages, emergency, sound, vibration) but users.service.ts:297 updateNotificationSettings stores only channels and categories and GET returns only those, so the app flags are never saved and the web cannot show the app kinds or sound/vibration.
suspect: Backend: persist and return the flat flags (or map them onto categories) so both clients edit one stored setting; then the web can add emergency (locked), sound and vibration rows (switch-list.tsx:18, notifications/page.tsx).

element: unread dot on the notification bell
found: [backend] the backend notifications controller has no unread-count endpoint and the proxy allowlist has none; the bell cannot show a dot without an extra request per page.
suspect: Backend to add GET /notifications/unread-count; the home keeps one session request per page by design (F82).

found: [owner] the app keeps a device-only preference read by its date helpers; the web formatters (lib/format-date) do not read one, so a switch would do nothing.
suspect: Owner to decide if the web shows Hijri dates, then wire lib/format-date first.

element: sort, filter sidebar, pharmacies tab, price cards
found: [backend] GET /search takes q, locale and limit only and returns no price or sale fields.
suspect: Needs backend filter/sort params before the board's sidebar can be wired.

found: [owner] /drug-scanner is an app screen (camera); no web equivalent exists.
suspect: Owner to decide if the web needs a scan flow.

found: [owner] Owner decision 2026-10-24: saved addresses first, adding opens the picker. Web: the list (select mode via ?select=1) comes first and adding offers "Use my current location" and the National Address code. A draggable pin needs a map library (none in patient-web; the OSM iframe cannot report a pin).
suspect: Owner: approve a map library (e.g. Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles) for a draggable pin, or accept the current options; nothing was added.

found: [backend] the Patient Contract V1 register takes one identifier; the app sends email and phone together (legacy payload).
suspect: Backend to confirm one contract for both clients.

found: [backend] GET /users/me/sessions sends a masked IP, not a place; the row shows the masked IP.
suspect: Backend to add a coarse location if the owner wants it.

found: [backend] app shows sound and vibration switches (flat keys, same PATCH); the backend does not store them (see the kinds entry), so a web switch would not persist.
suspect: Backend persists sound/vibration; web adds the two rows afterwards.

element: provider app store and web links
found: [owner] The page shown to a provider account on the patient site reads its links from NEXT_PUBLIC_PROVIDER_WEB_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_PROVIDER_APP_IOS_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_PROVIDER_APP_ANDROID_URL. The repo has no store URLs and only the backend env example names https://provider.nabd.plus (PROVIDER_APP_BASE_URL), so none is hard-coded.
suspect: Owner supplies the real store URLs and confirms the provider web address; each link is hidden while unset. Dockerfile.patient-web needs the matching build args.
